title: Strange stitching raises quality suspicions
text: Strange stitching raises quality suspicions. The important thing is that my daughter likes it, it is comfy and light but warm. The pillow cases fit, the colors are pretty and vibrant, HOWEVER... it has very weird and strange sewing. I don't quite understand if it is a fluke or intentional, but it appears to be weird circular stitches at random points. If it is intentional, they should rethink it because it looks cheap and like a mistake.
